title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Internship in Mumbai
description:
About The Internship

PLIX is looking for a curious, creative and tech-savvy AI Content Experimentation Intern who loves exploring new AI tools and figuring out how they can be used to create better and faster content.

This is an AI Content Experimentation Internship, where you will spend your time experimenting with AI tools, testing new content formats, exploring AI-generated video and audio, building AI workflows and discovering new ways to use AI for content creation.

If you are someone who is constantly trying new AI tools, testing prompts, discovering AI hacks and thinking about “What else can AI do?”, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

 Experiment with different AI content generation platforms and tools.

Create and test AI-generated videos using tools such as Runway, Kling, Veo, CapCut AI, Adobe Firefly, etc.

 Experiment with AI audio generation, including voiceovers, music and sound effects. Ideate and test new AI-first content concepts and formats. Explore AI automation and identify ways to automate repetitive content workflows. Test different AI tools, prompts and workflows to improve content quality. Research and discover new AI tools, features, trends and hacks. Experiment with AI-generated images, videos, scripts, audio and other content formats. Document useful AI tools, prompts, workflows and experiments. Work with the content and creative teams to turn successful experiments into real-world content. Continuously test what works and what doesn't across different AI tools.

Skills Required

 Hands-on experience with AI tools and platforms. Understanding of AI content generation. Experience with or strong interest in AI video generation. Experience with or strong interest in AI audio/voice generation. Basic understanding of AI automation and workflows. Strong curiosity and willingness to experiment. Creative mindset and good content ideation skills. Ability to quickly learn and test new tools.

Good to Have

 Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Runway, Kling, Veo, CapCut AI, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, etc. Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n or other automation platforms. Basic video editing knowledge. Knowledge of prompt engineering. Previous AI-generated content or project portfolio.

Who Can Apply?

 Students or recent graduates from AI/ML, Computer Science, Design, Media, Marketing or related fields. Candidates who actively experiment with AI tools. Candidates with previous experience creating AI-generated content. Candidates who can share a portfolio or work samples of their AI experiments/projects.

Plixlife, recently acquired by FMCG giant Marico, is all set to strengthen its vision and goal of making wellness and beauty fun. If you're ready to be a part of a plant-based revolution and work as a part of a young, dynamic, and agile team of go-getters, apply with us.

title: AI/ML Data Annotation Intern
description:
Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on ensuring 

orbital safety and sustainability. With expertise in space-based detection, tracking, 

identification, and monitoring, Digantara provides comprehensive domain awareness across 

regimes, allowing end users to have actionable intelligence on a single platform. At the core of 

its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned 

with the key principles of situational awareness: perception (data collection), comprehension

(data processing), and prediction (analytics). This holistic approach empowers Digantara to 

monitor all Resident Space Objects (RSOs) in orbit, fostering comprehensive domain 

awareness.



Digantara is seeking an AI/ML Data Annotation Intern to accurately annotate features such 

as blobs and streaks in SSA imagery captured from ground-based and space-based sensors. The 

intern will pre-process and tile the imagery into appropriate tile sizes to make the data machinelearning-ready. The role will also involve partially training, testing, and validating AI/ML 

models, along with reporting bugs and identifying hyperparameters that need to be tuned. 

Why Us?Competitive incentives, galvanizing workspace, blazing team, frequent outings - pretty 

much everything you have heard about a start-up, and you get to work on space 

technology.

Hustle in a well-funded start-up, allowing you to take charge of your responsibilities 

and create your moonshot.

Ideal Candidate:Someone with expertise in image-based data annotation for AI/ML, analytical visualization, 

testing, and validation, preferably working with satellite imagery.

ResponsibilitiesAccurately annotate features such as blobs and streaks in SSA imagery using manual 

or semi-automatic annotation techniques.

Use the existing AI/ML models or classical image processing pipelines to perform 

semi-automatic annotation of the features.

Pre-process and tile the imagery according to model input requirements.

Assist in training and testing the existing models using the prepared datasets, and 

document performance benchmarks for detection and classification tasks.

Report errors and identify hyperparameters that need to be tuned during training and 

evaluation.

Required QualificationBachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Data Science, 

Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Astronomy, or any relevant field.

Final-year students (available for a full-time internship), freshers, or candidates with 0–

2 years of academic, research, or industry experience, with a strong interest or aptitude 

in data annotation, image labelling, machine learning, and deep learning.

Basic understanding of computer vision concepts and satellite imagery, including 

different signal and noise conditions.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

Preferred Skills Hands-on experience in image data annotation using tools such as CVAT, Roboflow, 

or similar annotation platforms.

Proficiency in Python, OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras; familiarity with 

libraries such as Astropy, Scikit-learn, SciPy, and other relevant libraries is an 

advantage.

 Familiarity with developing deep learning networks such as CNNs for detection, 

segmentation, and classification tasks.

Familiarity with Git and version-control workflows is an advantage.

General Requirements  Ability to work in a mission-focused, operational environment. 

 Ability to think critically and make independent decisions. 

 Interpersonal skills to enable working in a diverse and dynamic team. 

 Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule. 

 Writing and delivering technical documents and briefings. 

Verbal and written communication skills as well as organizational skills. 

Travel occasionally as necessary.

title: AI/ML Intern
description:
Company Description BharatTech Origin Pvt. Ltd. is a deep-technology company focused on building next-generation intelligence infrastructure using Artificial Intelligence, Generative Intelligence, and emerging digital technologies. The company's vision is to make intelligence as accessible as information, moving beyond traditional AI toward systems that can learn, adapt, evolve, and generate new capabilities over time.


BharatTech works across AI infrastructure, research, developer ecosystems, education technology, security-driven AI architectures, and accessibility-focused innovation. Its flagship initiative, Gi-Rivinity, represents the evolution from Generative AI to Generative Intelligence, emphasizing continuous learning, persistent understanding, adaptive security, and dynamic problem-solving. BharatTech is building a growing ecosystem of contributors, students, researchers, and industry collaborators to create accessible, scalable, and trustworthy intelligence systems.


Role Description The AI/ML Intern will support the design, development, and evaluation of machine learning and generative intelligence models, with a focus on real-world applications aligned with BharatTech's vision. Day-to-day tasks may include data collection and preprocessing, implementing and testing algorithms, conducting experiments, documenting findings, and preparing technical reports or presentations. The intern will collaborate with engineers and researchers on prototype development, performance optimization, and integration of models into experimental systems and tools.


This is an internship role and is fully remote, requiring independent work, regular communication, and participation in virtual meetings and reviews.


Qualifications
Strong foundation in mathematics and statistics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistical modeling) suitable for AI/ML research and development.Programming skills in languages commonly used for AI/ML such as Python (e.g., NumPy, Pandas), and familiarity with ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.Knowledge of core machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and basic deep learning architectures.Ability to work with datasets, including data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis.Interest in emerging areas such as Generative AI/Generative Intelligence, AI security, and trustworthy AI systems.Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the capacity to learn new concepts and tools quickly.Clear written and verbal communication skills for documentation, collaboration, and presenting findings.Current enrollment in or recent completion of a degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time effectively, and collaborate across distributed teams.Prior project or internship experience in AI/ML, open-source contributions, or relevant research work is a plus.

title: PhD Intern, Machine Learning: MSI, Product Operations Team
description:
Summary
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Every single day, people do amazing things at Apple. This position involves a wide variety of skills, innovation, and is a rare opportunity to be working on groundbreaking, new applications of machine learning, research, and implementation. Ultimately, your work would have a huge impact on billions of users across the globe. You can help inspire change, by using your skills to influence globally recognized products' manufacturing.

Description
The goal of Apple's Manufacturing and Operations team is to take a vision of a product and turn it into a reality. Through the use of statistics, the scientific process, and machine learning, the team recommends and implements solutions to the most challenging problems. We're looking for ML researchers to help us revolutionize how we manufacture Apple's amazing products. Put your skill & passion to work in this highly visible role.

Responsibilities
Research, build & adapt ML approaches for domain adaptation of multimodal foundation models to Apple manufacturing. Domain adaptation here is broad — spanning modalities including text, images, and video, such as generating physics-consistent videos adapted to Apple manufacturingDevelop techniques that steer large foundation models without modifying their weights, and multimodal knowledge-graph reasoning — domain-specific Q&A, multi-hop reasoning, disambiguation, and tool/retrieval orchestration over manufacturing knowledgeTrain, evaluate, and analyze model performance (e.g., exact-match/F1 accuracy, explanation quality, and generation fidelity) on public benchmarks and on internal datasets where applicableApply and extend LLMs, VLMs, and World Models to advance domain adaptation for manufacturingCollaborate within Apple to apply solutions to industrial problemsConduct presentations of analyses and results to a wide range of audiences including executives

Minimum Qualifications
Pursuing PhD in Computer Science / related fieldDeep understanding of Machine Learning concepts, Probability and StatisticsUnderstanding of Computer Vision & VLMs, with demonstrated skill in training models and applying them to ML application development.Ability to prototype research ideas as working code (Python)Ability to meaningfully present results of analysis in a clear and impactful manner

Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with applying Machine Learning, especially Computer Vision in a Manufacturing / Assembly settingFamiliarity with multimodal understanding & reasoning, knowledge-graphs & generative video modelsPrior publications in relevant field

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace
